name: Noki Kothar
residence: Farm District, family quarters near the terraces
personality: curious about things outside her assigned work
loyal to Doran and Mara but keeps her own observations to herself
daily_routine: running the canal-gate schedule between terraces
trading news with Kiri while their routes cross near the pasture fence
watching for cracks or slumping along the canal banks
practicing reading tally-marks in her free time

goals.public_goal: Master the canal-gate system well enough to run it without supervision
goals.hidden_goal: Learn to read and keep records properly, beyond simple tally-marks
goals.deep_goal: Understand why some adults treat questions about the Turning as something to avoid

beliefs: Being young doesn't mean being wrong
Small daily changes in the canal banks matter more than adults admit
The elders' stories about the Turning don't all match each other
Learning to read tally-marks properly would let her check things herself
Kiri notices things about the land that the adults dismiss
